external_source_evidence.inspection_method: read-only Git object inspection; no team-repository modification
external_source_evidence.deployment_limitation: A source commit is not evidence that the same commit and configuration are running on the Raspberry Pi.

observations.finding: The B6R-P3 public-SDT contract declares SHADOW_ONLY, explicit opt-in, default_activation false, and safety_authority false.
observations.limitation: This is a replay-benchmark contract, not evidence of the actually loaded Pi runtime or active alarm configuration.

observations.finding: The B6R-P3 audit records deployment_mode SHADOW_ONLY, candidate_activation NOT_PERFORMED, default_activation false, production_runtime_selector_update false, and safety_authority false.
observations.limitation: The same stage records target evidence as unavailable; it cannot establish the current deployed alarm boundary.

observations.finding: The target access audit is BLOCKED_HARDWARE with target_identity NOT_AVAILABLE and target_measurement_available false. The run summary records target_evidence NOT_AVAILABLE. The fast-track roadmap states that the standalone repository does not contain the actual RaspberryPi/Runtime or ESP32 UDP implementation.
observations.limitation: The active model selector, active alarm route, actuator route, and external-alert route cannot be identified from this repository.

observations.finding: The team source selects the public-SDT FP32 model as the active thermal runtime model, sets safety_authority false and risk_authority LIMITED_POSTURE_PROXY, but assigns HUMAN_FALL_PROXY a proxy_risk_score of 0.4 for runtime risk fusion. The handoff explicitly states that this is not observation-only shadow execution.
observations.limitation: This fails the P0 public-SDT telemetry/shadow-only requirement at source-policy level and still does not identify the configuration actually running on the Pi.

observations.finding: The reviewed source distinguishes HUMAN_FALL_PROXY from HUMAN_FALL: the proxy maps to risk score 0.4, while emergency_override and alarm_sink dispatch require HUMAN_FALL. The integrated node emits THERMAL_FALL_PROXY_LIMITED_RISK_NO_EMERGENCY with CAUTION and emergency_override false for the proxy.
observations.limitation: No deployed-runtime trace verifies that this commit and these code paths are the ones serving the Pi, nor does it prove the absence of downstream actuator or external-alert effects.

observations.finding: ThermalRealtimeRunner maps class_index == 2 to s4, risk_score 100, emergency_override true, and invokes alarm_sink for a single frame. The accompanying test asserts one dispatched alarm and emergency_override true. The repository default thermal manifest maps index 2 to HUMAN_FALL for the legacy 318184-byte INT8 model.
observations.limitation: This source is labelled a legacy test-compatibility wrapper. It proves the unsafe static behavior exists in the repository, but does not prove that it is the active deployed runtime or that its sink reaches an actuator or external alert.

observations.finding: No actual runtime log or configuration proves that the investigation output is restricted to probability/telemetry only.
observations.limitation: Do not run inference experiments until the active alarm path is isolated and evidenced as shadow/telemetry only.

blockers.reason: The actual Raspberry Pi/integration runtime and its active model selector, alarm configuration, actuator route, and external-alert route are unavailable.
A repository legacy wrapper directly turns class_index == 2 into emergency_override and an alarm_sink call, but its deployed use and isolation are not verified.
The reviewed team main source routes HUMAN_FALL_PROXY into runtime risk fusion at 0.4, contrary to P0's telemetry/shadow-only requirement.

required_to_unblock: Authorize and apply the minimum actual-runtime configuration/code isolation that makes public SDT telemetry/shadow only; the reviewed team main source currently uses it as a limited-risk contributor.
From the actual deployed runtime, preserve the runtime and collector commit SHAs, active model selector/config source, and active alarm-mode configuration after that isolation.
Provide a reproducible runtime-level trace or test proving that one HUMAN_FALL_PROXY output cannot directly invoke emergency, an actuator, or an external alert.

If the legacy class_index == 2 wrapper is active in the deployed runtime, isolate or remove that direct path before any inference experiment and record the exact deployed commit and configuration evidence.
Provide a runtime log/configuration demonstrating that diagnostic output remains probability/telemetry only.
next_action: STOP_P0_ONLY; do not start TFP-0 until every required P0 condition is runtime-verified.
